title: Design System: Factus - La Forma Libre

ui.purpose: Body text, headings, form inputs, buttons. The neutral reading face.

mono.purpose: Module headers, table column names, captions, date stamps, receipt brand, numeric labels. The 'printed form' voice.

shadows.name: modal-lift
shadows.purpose: The only module-level shadow in the system. Used on modal content to detach from the paper plane.

shadows.name: dropdown-float
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and floating panels. Must visually detach from the page surface.

shadows.name: login-sheet
shadows.purpose: Login form card. The only static surface that lifts - it sits alone on the Papel ground.

motion.name: ease-nav-link
motion.purpose: Sidebar nav link hover/active color and background transitions. Fast, nearly imperceptible.

motion.name: ease-form-focus
motion.purpose: Input field border and focus ring transitions. Subtle shift to Azul Carbon.

motion.name: ease-button
motion.purpose: Button hover background transitions. Same speed as nav links for consistency.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sole accent button. Azul Carbon fill, white text, flat and sealed.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--carbono, #2a4782); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--carbono, #2a4782); border-radius: var(--radio-hoja, 4px); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--carbono-osc, #1e3463); border-color: var(--carbono-osc, #1e3463); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px var(--carbono, #2a4782); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: var(--carbono-suave, #7488b4); border-color: var(--carbono-suave, #7488b4); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/outline button for non-primary actions. Transparent fill, slate text, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--tinta-2, #4d545c); border: 1px solid var(--agua-2, #c3c8d0); border-radius: var(--radio-hoja, 4px); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--acero, #eceef1); color: var(--tinta, #20242b); border-color: var(--agua-3, #adb4be); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px var(--carbono, #2a4782); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { color: var(--tinta-3, #5f666e); border-color: var(--agua, #d9dce1); background: transparent; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard form input. White surface, strong hairline border, Azul Carbon focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--hoja, #ffffff); color: var(--tinta, #20242b); border: 1px solid var(--agua-2, #c3c8d0); border-radius: var(--radio-hoja, 4px); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(117, 124, 133, 0.7); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--carbono, #2a4782); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(42, 71, 130, 0.18); } .ds-input.is-invalid { border-color: var(--sello-rojo, #a9241c); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(169, 36, 28, 0.16); }

components.name: Module Card
components.description: The invoice-section container. White surface, hairline border, optional steel-gray header with monospaced placard label.

components.name: Badge Chip
components.description: Status indicator. Transparent fill, colored stroke, icon + text. Never color alone.
components.html: Contado

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Dark sidebar link. Transparent at rest, white fill on hover, white card with blue left-edge accent when active.
components.html: Inicio Productos
components.css: .ds-sidebar { background: #1d232c; padding: 0.6rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radio-hoja, 4px); color: rgba(238, 240, 243, 0.66); font-size: 0.88rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.12s ease, color 0.12s ease; } .ds-nav-link svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: rgba(238, 240, 243, 0.4); transition: color 0.12s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); } .ds-nav-link:hover svg { color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); } .ds-nav-active { color: #14181f; background: var(--hoja, #ffffff); border-color: var(--hoja, #ffffff); font-weight: 600; position: relative; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -0.65rem; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px; background: var(--carbono, #2a4782); } .ds-nav-active svg { color: var(--carbono, #2a4782); }

narrative.overview:
Factus looks like a single, never-ending planilla mercantil - a commercial invoice sheet that has been torn into modules. Every screen is a section of that same document: the paper is always white (Papel Algodon), the ink is always slate (Tinta Pizarra), and the only accent is the single Azul Carbon that would appear on a carbon-copy form. There are no gradient fills, no glassmorphism, no drop shadows at rest, no rounded corners wider than a thumb's breadth. The visual language is a direct rejection of SaaS defaults - no soft-shadow cards, no pastel gradient headers, no frosted navbars. Every pixel is drawn in ink on paper.

The system runs on-premises in Venezuelan bodegas without internet: cashiers at the counter need to process sales fast, in dual currency, with receipts that print on thermal paper. The typeface choice - system fonts only, zero web fonts - is a constraint born from offline deployment, but it becomes the aesthetic: the mechanical precision of ui-monospace for labels and tabular data, and the clean neutrality of system-ui for body text. Numbers always use tabular-nums lining figures so columns of currency align without fuss.

Every module on screen is a hairline-bordered box that could be a section of a physical invoice form. Module headers are stamped in uppercase monospaced caps (the placard voice). Status badges carry both an icon and a colored stroke - never color alone. Buttons are flat ink stamps with no elevation at rest. The result is a POS that feels like operating a well-organized ledger book, not a modern web application.
keyCharacteristics: Papel (cotton-white) ground, Tinta (slate) text, Azul Carbon single accent
Hairline borders everywhere; no shadows at rest
Monospaced uppercase placard labels for module headers, captions, and date stamps
Tabular-nums lining figures on every numeric value
Status badges: icon + stroke, never bare color
System fonts only (system-ui + ui-monospace); zero web font requests
Flat, sealed buttons with ink-on-paper weight

rules.name: The Pamper-Only-One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Azul Carbon is the only chromatic accent in the system. No other hue is used for interactive elements, links, or emphasis at full saturation. State seals are semantic signals, not competing accents.

rules.name: The Border-Tells-The-Story Rule
rules.body: Depth in this system is communicated entirely through hairline border weight and tonal background shifts (Acero Claro headers, Acero Fantasma stripes), never through drop shadows. Cards have box-shadow: none !important.

rules.name: The State-Seal-Pair Rule
rules.body: Every state color is always deployed as a pair: the dark hue for text/icon stroke plus the pale pastel for background wash. Never use the dark hue as a background fill at full opacity on large areas.

rules.name: The Monospaced-Placard Rule
rules.body: All structural labels - module headers, table column names, metric captions, receipt field names, date stamps, and the rate strip - are set in uppercase monospaced type with generous letter-spacing (0.06em-0.22em). This is the printed form voice. Body text and interactive elements use UI font; only structural annotations use mono.

rules.name: The Tabular-Figures-Everywhere Rule
rules.body: The html element sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums globally. Every number in the system - prices, quantities, rates, dates, KPIs - aligns in columns without explicit width hacks. This is non-negotiable for a dual-currency POS.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: All module surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on floating overlays (modals, dropdowns) that must visually detach from the paper plane. Dashboard cards, table containers, and form panels never cast shadows.

dos: Do use hairline borders and tonal background shifts to create depth - never drop shadows on module surfaces.
Do set all structural labels (module headers, table columns, captions, receipt fields) in uppercase monospaced with generous letter-spacing.
Do pair every state seal color with its pastel wash: dark hue for text/icon, pale hue for background tinting.
Do use tabular-nums on every numeric value (globally set on html, but verify in custom contexts).
Do keep Azul Carbon as the sole interactive accent. Focus rings, links, active states, and primary buttons use this color and only this color.
Do use 4px radius uniformly on all surfaces - cards, inputs, buttons, badges, modals, receipts.
Do include an icon alongside every status badge text. Color alone is not sufficient.
Do use Bootstrap's system of utility classes (btn-*, text-*, bg-*, border-*) since the CSS custom property bridge maps them to the palette automatically.
donts: Don't add box-shadow to cards, tables, or module containers. The only exceptions are modals and dropdown menus.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, backdrop-filter, or any translucent overlay on module surfaces.
Don't introduce a second accent hue for interactive elements. State seals are semantic signals, not clickable accents.
Don't use pill-shaped buttons, circular avatars, or varied border-radius values. 4px is the universal radius.
Don't load web fonts (Google Fonts, Adobe Fonts, or self-hosted woff files). The type system is built entirely from OS-native fonts for offline reliability.
Don't use color alone to convey status. Every badge and state indicator must carry an icon.
Don't make module headers any background other than Acero Claro (#eceef1). The header is the formstamp of the invoice.
Don't use the receipt's 2px total separator anywhere except the receipt total and login header. That weight is reserved for ink stamp moments.
